ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

basic.note: Default block code with TypeScript highlighting and copy action.

commands.note: Command variant with a package-manager selector.

code-block.description: Block and inline code snippets with highlighting, copy, and expandable long content.

editable.note: Inline editing: the pencil button becomes save and emits the new code. Esc cancels, Ctrl+Enter saves.

examples.note: Start with the default block, then explore layouts and variants below.

expandable.note: Long content collapses after four lines and expands on demand.

highlighting.note: Built-in fallback highlighting by default; Shiki is available through an optional provider.

installation.note: Install the single Solaris package, then import the component.

layouts.note: Inline layout for references inside text, block layout for examples.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.
